headlines.text: On this day in 2025, the AEW TBS Title was up for grabs as Mercedes Mone vs. Billie Starkz went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.03 ? a real highlight of the night. Mon? survived a strong challenge from the 20-year-old Starkz, locking in the Statement Maker to retain the TBS Championship.

This stood as the 60th match in AEW World Heavyweight Title history ? a genuinely rare milestone for that title.
